subject: PO activation & initial payment ramp for NimbusForge
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@nimbusforge.com>

Cc: NimbusForge Accounts <acct@nimbusforge.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding & first-month payment arrangement

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday — we appreciated the walkthrough of Redwood's PO process. To keep the initial onboarding on schedule, NimbusForge is requesting a slight modification to payment timing for the first three invoices related to the integration engagement. Our standard onboarding cash flow is tight in the ramp month, and we usually ask for either Net 30 or a short early-settlement option in exchange for a small discount.

Proposal:
- Standard PO and vendor setup per Redwood process
- Redwood issues PO for Week-of-Nov 24 launch
- Payment terms for first three invoices: Net 30 OR Net45 with an early-settlement option (payment in 20 days) for a 1.5% prompt payment discount
- After three invoices, revert to contracted Net45

We can provide a signed onboarding form and W-9 immediately and are happy to execute any vendor addendum you require. I attached the onboarding form and W-9 for speed.

Attachments: [Attachment: Nimbus_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: W9_Nimbus.pdf (application/pdf)]

Would Marcus from Finance or someone on your team be able to review the early-settlement option? We can be flexible on the exact mechanism (credit memo vs. invoice reduction) — whatever Redwood prefers.

Thanks,
Elena Garcia
Head of Operations
NimbusForge

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:27:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding & first-month payment arrangement

Vanessa / Laura — quick finance read on NimbusForge's ask. We try to avoid permanent deviations from our Net terms unless there's a strong business case. That said, for strategic integrations I'm willing to make a short-term accommodation with controls. Options:

1) Approve the request with an internal finance fee: keep Net45 as baseline, offer an early-settlement option of payment within 20 days at a 1.0% discount (instead of the requested 1.5%). Finance will capture the discount as a settlement fee in the invoice line so accounting is clean.

2) Approve Net30 for the first three invoices only (no discount), revert to Net45 after that.

3) If Nimbus insists on 1.5% for 20-day settlement, escalate to Legal + VP Finance for one-off approval.

Recommended: Option 1 (Net45 baseline + 20-day early settlement at 1.0% fee). It balances cash flow and gives Nimbus some relief without setting a new precedent. Laura — do we need a short addendum to the vendor agreement or is a signed email and PO note sufficient?

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.com
